result.markdown: --- title: >- [fmt_currency()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-function} body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Format a number as a currency value. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/example-python-package/blob/main/tinytab/_formats.py#L129-L180){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python fmt_currency( x, *, currency="USD", ) ``` ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [x]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The amount to format. [currency]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [["USD"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : A three-letter currency code (case-insensitive). Yen values are shown without decimal places. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The formatted amount, with the currency symbol. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Amounts are in US dollars by default: ::: {#3ab3696a .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} from tinytab import fmt_currency fmt_currency(1234.5) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` '$1,234.50' ``` ::: ::: Choose another currency with its three-letter code, in any case. Negative amounts put the sign before the symbol: ::: {#d619503d .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} fmt_currency(-5, currency="gbp") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` '-£5.00' ``` ::: ::: Yen are shown without decimal places: ::: {#c1e934ee .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} fmt_currency(1234.5, currency="JPY") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ``` '¥1,234' ``` ::: :::
